text:
ana: Putting up a short sync: "sandbox certification runway" Thurs 3pm PT. Focus: on-prem bundle handling, HSM-backed signatures, manifest v2 feature flags, and sandbox-only marketplace listing. RSVP.

kevin: I'll join. We need a clear contract for offline artifact verification for air-gapped customers (hash + signed attest + transfer checklist).

sam: On manifest v2: propose `features: ["quantized","hw-accel"]` and `compat: {aliases:[], families:[]}`  but we should avoid deep breaking changes. Maybe support a compatibility shim in gateway.

devon: Partner Eng will show `rw-verify` sample that can validate HSM signatures and offline attest. Example CLI: `rw-verify bundle.tgz --attest sig.json --hsm-cert cert.pem`. We'll mark bundles without HSM as lower trust tier.

marta: For sandbox marketplace: partners want same-day blog + listing sometimes, but for air-gapped/regulated customers we should delay public announcement until certification is done. Recommend a staged release flag in the bundle meta.

ana: tiny correction: "ana" above meant to close.

partner-bot: Reminder created: "Sandbox certification runway" Thurs 15:00 PT (organizer: ana).

kevin: Action items: devon publish verify CLI draft, sam publish manifest v2 RFC, marta coordinate embargo windows with GTM.

sam: I'll also add a short adapter shim example for `model_family` -> `alias` fallback so LangChain adapters don't break.

devon: Sounds good. I'll push the demo to partners repo by Wed EOD.

ana: thanks all, will post calendar invite and attach a short preflight checklist.
